review_kind: single independent full-context source/pixel figure review

source_fidelity.method: Original PNG opened separately at original resolution and independently inventoried before reading its spec/inventory.
independent_inventory: One cylinder with thick insulating left/right walls and bottom.
A lower solid hatched piston spanning the chamber with a solid central rod.
An upper dashed outline of that same piston and its dashed central rod, sharing the lower position's horizontal alignment; not a second physical piston.
Exactly two upward arrows: one above the lower rod and one above the upper dashed rod.
Gas-dot cloud below the lower solid piston, no gas markers outside the chamber and no heat-flow arrows.
One insulation label below the apparatus, faithfully localized as Insulated shell.
source_fidelity.modern_regularization: Dimensions, dashed/hatch spacing and the 63-marker gas cloud are schematic, not source measurements, a density dataset, a displacement measurement or an inferred work amount.

relationships: same-piston-width and upward-position-change retain the same horizontal piston extent and higher later position.
lower-motion-ends and upper-motion-ends bind both arrows with upward direction.
Solid/dashed rod bases meet their respective piston tops; structured coordinates and actual pixels agree.
Every gas marker has a mapped inside assertion for the lower gas chamber.
The actual SVG preserves eight dashed border segments for the upper piston/rod, only one English text label and no external image references.

visual_semantics.assessment: Complete frozen n25 context contrasts fixed-volume heat loss with expansion without heat transfer and explicitly requires approximately non-heat-conducting walls and piston. The displayed insulated shell, lower solid state, upper dashed later position, two visible upward arrowheads and lower gas cloud support that contrast. No arrowhead is hidden by a rod/piston; no extra heat-flow arrow, formula, quantitative data or solution annotation is introduced. Insulated shell is legible and clear of the apparatus at all inspected widths. No cultural or non-English visible text leakage.

reviewer_edits: Only this scratch report; no figure, spec, author template, source or previous evidence changed.
limits: No prose-science repeat, answer access, browser, network/model calls, dependency/app/DB operations, promotion, finalize or commit. This is figure approval of the bound bytes only, not product/browser/publication acceptance.
